name: Release Package

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_version:
        description: 'Test version (e.g., 25.11-test)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  packages: read

jobs:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validation job – runs only for official tag pushes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  validate:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.set_version.outputs.version }}
      validated: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.validated }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Extract tag version
        id: set_version
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}
          echo "version=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Validate tag format
        id: validate
        run: |
          TAG=${{ steps.set_version.outputs.version }}
          if ! [[ "$TAG" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Tag '$TAG' does not match required format."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Read EGE_VERSION from header
          EGE_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'EGE_VERSION\s*=\s*"\K[^"]+' include/ege.h)
          if [[ "$TAG" != "$EGE_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Tag '$TAG' does not match EGE_VERSION '$EGE_VERSION'."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Ensure tag is reachable from master
          git fetch origin master
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor ${{ github.sha }} origin/master; then
            echo "::error::Tag '$TAG' is not on master."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "validated=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build matrix – runs for all three release types
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          # MSVC – 12 jobs (3 VS, 2 arch, 2 config)
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x86
            config: Debug
            vs_version: 2017
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x86
            config: Release
            vs_version: 2017
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x64
            config: Debug
            vs_version: 2017
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            vs_version: 2017
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x86
            config: Debug
            vs_version: 2019
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x86
            config: Release
            vs_version: 2019
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x64
            config: Debug
            vs_version: 2019
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            vs_version: 2019
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x86
            config: Debug
            vs_version: 2022
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x86
            config: Release
            vs_version: 2022
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x64
            config: Debug
            vs_version: 2022
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: msvc
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            vs_version: 2022
          # MinGW Windows – 3 jobs (64‑bit only)
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: mingw
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            mingw_version: 14.2
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: mingw
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            mingw_version: 13.1
          - os: windows-latest
            compiler: mingw
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            mingw_version: 14.2
          # Cross‑compile Ubuntu – 1 job
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            compiler: mingw
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            cross: true
          # Cross‑compile macOS – 1 job
          - os: macos-latest
            compiler: mingw
            arch: x64
            config: Release
            cross: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup MSBuild
        if: matrix.compiler == 'msvc'
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v1
        with:
          vs-version: ${{ matrix.vs_version }}
      - name: Install MinGW
        if: matrix.compiler == 'mingw'
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "Linux" ]]; then
              sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y mingw-w64
            elif [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
              brew install mingw-w64
            fi
          else
            choco install mingw
          fi
      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S .github/release-assets -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.config }} \
            -DCMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=${{ matrix.arch }} \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler == 'msvc' && 'cl' || 'gcc' }} \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler == 'msvc' && 'cl' || 'g++'
